cases.sentence: Датан и Авирам вышли и стояли с женами, сыновьями и ___ у входов в свои шатры.
cases.explain: «маленькими детьми» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: So they went away from the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram, on every side. Dathan and Abiram came out, and stood at the door of their tents with their wives, their sons, and their little ones.

cases.sentence: Священник Элеазар собрал ___, принесенные сожженными, и их разбили, чтобы покрыть жертвенник, 40 как повелел ему через Моисея Господь.
cases.explain: «бронзовые сосуды» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Eleazar the priest took the bronze censers which those who were burned had offered; and they beat them out for a covering of the altar,

cases.sentence: На ___ все общество израильтян роптало на Моисея и Аарона.
cases.explain: «другой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: But on the next day all the congregation of the children of Israel complained against Moses and against Aaron, saying, “You have killed Yahweh’s people!”
